newsitem.title: USA: Worldwide Equipment completes ARO deal.
newsitem.headline: Worldwide Equipment completes ARO deal.

text.p: Trading company Worldwide Equipment Corp said on Tuesday it completed the acquisition of all outstanding stock of privately owned ARO of America Inc for cash and securities.

Terms of the purchase were not disclosed, but Worldwide Equipment said in June it had received $756,000 in a private placement funding to serve its expansion program, and that it was seeking an additional $5 million in capital.
ARO, headquartered in Brunswick, Georgia, makes sports utility vehicles that are distributed and marketed in North America by East European Imports, a Miami-based company.
In a statement, Worldwide Equipment said East European had placed an initial order for $9.2 million in ARO merchandise.
Worldwide Equipment President Eilat Lev has taken on the additional post of president of ARO, the company added.
